tweets.text:
Q: Do I need to do anything to receive #ChildTaxCredit payments?
 
A: If you filed 2020 or 2019 taxes, or registered for stimulus checks, you're all set. If you didn't file taxes those years and did not register for stimulus checks, you can sign up here: https://t.co/SujJ0QFHVq.
tweets.text_resolved:
Q: Do I need to do anything to receive #ChildTaxCredit payments?
 
A: If you filed 2020 or 2019 taxes, or registered for stimulus checks, you're all set. If you didn't file taxes those years and did not register for stimulus checks, you can sign up here: https://www.whitehouse.gov/child-tax-credit/sign-up/.

tweets.text:
Q: When will I start receiving my #ChildTaxCredit payments?
 
A: The first direct deposits went out July 15. Future payments will go out on the 15th of every month. If you haven’t provided the IRS with your bank information, checks will be sent to the address the IRS has for you.

tweets.text:
Q: Will the #ChildTaxCredit affect my other federal benefits (like SSI, SNAP, WIC, or Housing)?
 
A: No. Receiving Child Tax Credit payments is not considered income for any family. Therefore, it will not change the amount you receive in other Federal benefits.
